record.label: Fold-pure nonlinear-Z-initialized C8v2 state
record.summary: Fold-pure reconstruction and epoch-zero parity pass. C8v2 improves nonlinear-Z by 0.323562% at OOF MSE 3.0439647586e-8, improves all 4 folds, wins 61.63% of networks, and reaches paired z=7.38. It remains scientific-only because native is 2.9736792466e-8, native wins are only 18.90%, and the projected adjusted 1.9422354385e-8 loses to D4 #328622.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed as a positive scientific-only discriminator. No direct integration or submission is licensed; only a target-blind successor that passes the absolute native and D4 gates may advance.
